description:
Pull DataForSEO Labs domain_intersection for (site_domain, competitor_domain) and return the keywords the competitor ranks for in Google search that the user's site doesn't — plus keywords where the competitor outranks the user. Sibling SKU to mine_competitor_prompts: that one is AI-engine citation gap, this one is classic SEO ranking gap.

Billing: 25¢ per run. The same site, competitor, location, language and limit within 24h is served from cache free (charged_cents=0). Not billed when the site_id or competitor_domain is rejected, or when no keywords come back (charged_cents=0).

When to call: the user asks 'what does <competitor> rank for that we don't', 'show me Google content gap vs <competitor>', 'keywords <competitor> ranks for'.

Returns: { rows: [{keyword, search_volume, cpc_cents, kd, intent, competitor_position, user_position, competitor_url, user_url, gap_kind: 'they_rank_we_dont'|'they_outrank_us'|'co_ranked'}], user_domain, competitor_domain, location_code, language_code, generated_at, cache_hit, charged_cents }.

The site_id must belong to this workspace and the competitor_domain must be on the site's competitor list (list_sites shows site_ids and each site's competitor_domains; a rejected domain returns error competitor_not_on_site with valid_competitor_domains).

Example: { site_id: "...", competitor_domain: "asana.com", location_code: 2840, language_code: "en" }

competitor_domain.description: Must be on the site's competitor_domains list (see list_sites).

language_code.description: Default: the location's language (en for US/UK/CA/AU, de for DE, fr for FR…).

limit.description: Max keywords per intersection mode, 10–100. Default 100.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code. Default 2840 (US). 2826 UK, 2124 CA, 2036 AU, 2276 DE, 2250 FR.

name: find_content_gap
title: Find Google-search keywords a competitor ranks for that this site doesn't
